pending_interview.category: System design (general) — scalability patterns; designing common systems like a URL shortener, rate limiter, chat system, notification system
pending_interview.question: You are asked to design a rate limiter — a system that prevents any single user or API client from making more requests than an allowed limit within a given time window (for example, no more than 1,000 requests per minute per user). Walk through how you would design this system to work reliably at scale, where "scale" means thousands of users making requests simultaneously across multiple servers. What data store would you use and why? What algorithm would you use to track and enforce the limit? What tradeoffs does your approach involve, and what breaks if a server goes down or a new server is added?
